title: "Movie Analysis"

format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
movies <- read_csv("data/movies.csv")
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
movies_clean <- movies |>
  separate_rows(genre, sep = ",\\s*")
```

```{r}
movies_gap <- movies_clean |>
  filter(
    is.na(tomatoMeter) | tomatoMeter != 0,
    is.na(audienceScore) | audienceScore != 0
  ) |>
  mutate(gap = tomatoMeter - audienceScore)

movies_summary <- movies_gap |>
  group_by(genre) |>
  summarise(mean_gap = mean(gap, na.rm = TRUE), n = n()) |>
  filter(n >= 100) |>
  arrange(mean_gap)
```

```{r}
ggplot(movies_summary, aes(x = mean_gap, y = fct_reorder(genre, mean_gap))) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    title = "Average Critic-Audience Gap by Genre",
    subtitle = "Negative gaps favor audiences; positive gaps favor critics",
    x = "Mean Tomatometer - Audience Score",
    y = "Genre"
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(movies, aes(x = tomatoMeter)) +
  geom_histogram(na.rm = TRUE) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Tomatometer Scores",
    subtitle = paste("Number of films:", nrow(movies)),
    x = "Tomatometer Score",
    y = "Count"
  )
```

```{r}
spiderman <- movies |>
  filter(title %in% c(
    "Spider-Man",
    "Spider-Man 2",
    "Spider-Man 3",
    "The Amazing Spider-Man",
    "The Amazing Spider-Man 2",
    "Spider-Man: Homecoming",
    "Spider-Man: Far From Home",
    "Spider-Man: No Way Home"
  )) |>
  mutate(
    actor = case_when(
      title %in% c("Spider-Man", "Spider-Man 2", "Spider-Man 3") ~ "Tobey Maguire",
      str_detect(title, "^The Amazing Spider-Man") ~ "Andrew Garfield",
      str_detect(title, "^Spider-Man:") ~ "Tom Holland"
    ),
    gap = tomatoMeter - audienceScore
  ) |>
  arrange(releaseDateTheaters)

spiderman |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(tomatoMeter, audienceScore),
    names_to = "score_type",
    values_to = "score"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    score_type = recode(
      score_type,
      tomatoMeter = "Tomatometer",
      audienceScore = "Audience"
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = fct_reorder(title, releaseDateTheaters),
    y = score,
    color = score_type,
    group = score_type
  )) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Critics Favored the Maguire Trilogy; Audiences Favored the Amazing Films",
    x = "Film (release order)",
    y = "Score",
    color = "Score"
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```
